lines.zh: 我的眼睛盯着你，可我动不了头。
lines.en: My eyes are on you, but my head won't turn.

lines.zh: 我四肢反着弯，一点点爬过来。
lines.en: My limbs bend backward as I crawl closer.

lines.zh: 我的影子先爬上墙，人却慢。
lines.en: My shadow climbs the wall first, though my body is slow.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，地就渗黑水。
lines.en: Each step I take leaves black water seeping up.

lines.zh: 我歪着头走路，脖子在响。
lines.en: I walk with my head tilted, neck creaking.

lines.zh: 苍白的皮肤反射着月光

lines.en: No eyes in these violet sockets.
In those eyes, only hate is left.
It extends its arms towards you
Its eyes are filled with fear
It hisses a warning at you

lines.zh: 这具尸体，被别的东西牵着走。
lines.en: This corpse is pulled along by something else.
Red light glows in zombie eyes

lines.zh: 附身的东西在啃我的骨头。
lines.en: Whatever possesses me gnaws at my bones.

lines.zh: 苍白火焰在它眼中闪烁。
lines.en: Pale flames dance in its eyes.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，似乎在等待什么。
lines.en: It stares at you, waiting for something.

lines.zh: 它的双手扭曲，发出咯吱声。
你听到它喉咙里的低吼。
lines.en: You hear a low growl in its throat.

lines.zh: 它的眼中映出你的倒影。
它的眼睛突然变得空洞。
它冲向你，带着无尽的怨恨。

lines.en: You collide with its rigid body.

lines.zh: 它粗重的呼吸几乎把你撞倒。
lines.en: Its heavy breath almost knocks you down.

lines.zh: 它试图用破碎的手抓住你。
lines.en: It tries to grab you with its broken hands.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞击发出嘎吱声。
你感受到它的恶意冲击。
它的盔甲在你身上留下痕迹。
lines.en: Its armor leaves marks on you.

lines.zh: 它突然撞向你，你感到疼痛。
lines.en: It suddenly collides with you, causing pain.
You are knocked back by its force.

lines.zh: 它僵硬的拳头击打在你身上。

lines.en: Its voice is filled with desire.

lines.zh: 它用嘶哑的声音呼唤同类。
lines.en: It calls to its kind with a raspy voice.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的求偶吼声。
它的眼睛闪烁着求偶的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with mating desire.

lines.zh: 它在黑暗中发出求偶的嘶吼。
lines.en: It roars a mating call in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它试图吸引其他生物的注意。
lines.en: It tries to attract others with its call.

lines.zh: 它的叫声在夜空中回荡。
lines.en: Its call echoes in the night sky.

lines.zh: 苍白恶魔附体，僵尸更加疯狂。
lines.en: Possessed by pale demon, zombie goes wild.

lines.zh: 啃食腐肉，苍白之手环绕。
lines.en: Feasting on rot, pale hands surround.

lines.zh: 阴冷目光，穿透你的灵魂。
苍白之血，流淌在僵尸中。
lines.en: Pale blood flows in the zombie.

lines.zh: 被附身的恐怖，你无法逃避。
lines.en: Terror of possession, you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 苍白之灵，游荡在黑暗中。
lines.en: Pale spirit wanders in the dark.

lines.zh: 吞噬灵魂，苍白恶魔附身。
僵尸变异，苍白恶魔附体。
苍白之手，抓住你的灵魂。
苍白之爪，撕裂你的肉身。
附在我身上的东西，认出你了。
lines.en: The thing inside me has recognized you.

lines.zh: 苍白的光从我眼眶漏出来。
lines.en: Pale light leaks from my eye sockets.
A living one walks in, and the demon laughs.

lines.zh: 我体内的恶魔抬头看你了。
lines.en: The demon inside me lifts its head to look at you.
My fingers point at you on their own.

lines.zh: 苍白之眼，锁定你的弱点。

lines.en: Pale blade, cuts through the void.

lines.zh: 苍白之手，抓紧你的灵魂。
苍白之息，冻结你的生命。
苍白之光，照亮你的死路。
lines.en: Pale light, illuminates your path to death.

lines.zh: 苍白之魂，你的最后挣扎。
苍白之爪，撕开你的皮肤。
lines.en: Pale claw, rips through your skin.

lines.zh: 苍白之手，抓住你的命运。

lines.en: I press against the cave wall and wait for you.

lines.zh: 小恶魔在洞穴口张了张嘴。
lines.en: The little demon at the cave mouth opens its mouth.
First I blow your torch dim.

lines.zh: 我的指甲在石上划了三道。
lines.en: My nails scratch three lines in the stone.

lines.zh: 它教我怎么绕到你背后。
lines.en: It teaches me how to get behind you.
I will take your shadow first.

lines.zh: 洞里的水倒流，那是它在动。
lines.en: The water in the cave flows backward; that is it moving.

lines.zh: 我数着你迈了几步，等你累。
lines.en: I count your steps and wait for you to tire.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，挥舞着腐烂的手臂。
发出恐怖的嘶嘶声，逼近猎物。
lines.en: Screams terrifyingly, closing in on prey.

lines.zh: 挥动铁镐，试图砸开骨头。
lines.en: Swings pickaxe, trying to crack bones.

lines.zh: 发出痛苦的嚎叫，挣扎着爬行。
lines.en: Howls in pain, struggling to crawl.

lines.zh: 我的手臂伸长了一截，抓住你！
lines.en: My arm stretches a length and grabs you!
A pale hand clamps over your mouth!

lines.zh: 它借我的手，撕开你的肩膀！
lines.en: It uses my hand to tear your shoulder!
You struck me, and the wound laughed.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里发出两种声音！
lines.en: Two voices come out of my throat!

lines.zh: 把我打碎也没用，它还在！
lines.en: Breaking me is useless; it is still here!

lines.zh: 在受污染的地下洞穴中孵化。
从恶灵林的树木中掉下。
在阴暗的洞穴深处孵化。
在受污染的河流中被发现。
在恶灵沼泽的泥泞中徘徊。
在被诅咒的土地上苏醒。
从恶灵林的枯木中孵化。
lines.en: Hatches from Wither Woods' dead trees.

lines.zh: 这只僵尸的躯壳被借走了。
lines.en: This zombie's shell has been borrowed.

lines.zh: 苍白恶魔从裂缝里爬进尸体。
lines.en: The pale demon crawls from the crack into the corpse.

lines.zh: 洞穴的墙上多了一道白影。
lines.en: A white shape appears on the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我从恶灵林的黑土里坐起。
lines.en: I sit up out of the black soil of the haunted woods.
Fire climbs the rags down to my bones.

lines.zh: 我不必呼吸，可水把我压住。
lines.en: I need no air, yet the water pins me down.
The blast tears a chunk of rot off me.

lines.zh: 箭插进我的胸口，我照样往前走。
lines.en: An arrow in my chest, and I walk on regardless.
